stops.detail: The Paneveggio-Pale di San Martino Natural Park (Italian: Parco naturale Paneveggio-Pale di San Martino) is a nature reserve in Trentino, Italy. Established in 1967, it stretches over nearly 20,000 ha (49,000 acres) in the Dolomites (in the territory of seven municipalities, all in the Province of Trento), encompassing the Pale di San Martino massif, the Paneveggio forest, and the easternmost part of the Lagorai range, between the valleys of Fiemme, Fassa, Primiero, and Vanoi.
